sql:
WITH c AS (SELECT id, name FROM companies WHERE slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido')),
l AS (SELECT l.id, l.company_id, l.status FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM c) AND l.status IN ('novo', 'em_contato', 'orcamento_enviado', 'aguardando_resposta', 'cliente_retorno')),
cv AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.lead_id) w.lead_id, w.last_message_at, w.last_message_from_me, w.is_closed FROM wapi_conversations w WHERE w.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM c) AND w.lead_id IN (SELECT id FROM l) AND NOT w.is_equipe AND NOT w.is_freelancer AND w.remote_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' ORDER BY w.lead_id, w.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST),
x AS (SELECT l.company_id, l.status, cv.last_message_at AS t, cv.last_message_from_me AS me, coalesce(cv.is_closed, false) AS closed, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lead_visits v WHERE v.lead_id = l.id AND v.status_visita = 'realizada' AND v.data_visita::date >= current_date - 30) AS visitou FROM l LEFT JOIN cv ON cv.lead_id = l.id)
SELECT c.name AS empresa,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id) AS leads_abertos,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.t IS NULL) AS sem_conversa,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.me = false AND x.t < now() - interval '30 minutes' AND x.t > now() - interval '7 days') AS cliente_esperando_30min_7d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.me = false AND x.t < now() - interval '2 hours' AND x.t > now() - interval '7 days') AS cliente_esperando_2h_7d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.me = false AND x.t < now() - interval '24 hours' AND x.t > now() - interval '30 days') AS cliente_esperando_24h_30d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.me = false AND x.closed) AS esperando_mas_fechada,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.status = 'orcamento_enviado' AND x.me = true AND x.t < now() - interval '2 days' AND x.t > now() - interval '30 days') AS orcamento_2a30d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.status = 'orcamento_enviado') AS orcamento_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.visitou) AS visitou_30d_sem_fechar,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.status = 'aguardando_resposta' AND x.me = true AND x.t < now() - interval '3 days' AND x.t > now() - interval '30 days') AS negociando_3a30d,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.status = 'aguardando_resposta') AS negociando_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM x WHERE x.company_id = c.id AND x.status = 'em_contato') AS visita_total
FROM c ORDER BY c.name
